question_stem: A sample of a radioactive isotope emits a beam of $\beta^-$ radiation.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the change, if any, to the number of neutrons in a nucleus of the sample that emits a $\beta^-$ particle.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The number of $\beta^-$ particles passing a fixed point in the beam in a time of $2.0$ minutes is $9.8 \times 10^{10}$.

Calculate the current, in $\text{pA}$, produced by the beam of $\beta^-$ particles.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Suggest why the $\beta^-$ particles are emitted with a range of kinetic energies.
